caption: The drawing features a central square composition filled with an arrangement of repeating geometric patterns. The design encompasses vertical and horizontal bands, as well as checkerboard patterns. The central area has wide vertical stripes alternating between brown and a beige or off-white color. To either side of the central area, the vertical columns become narrower and more densely packed. The top and bottom edges of the square are filled with a checkerboard consisting of alternating squares in three colors: a muted pink, brown, and beige. Between these checkerboard sections and the central stripes, there are sections where the patterns transition from squares to vertical rectangles, maintaining the same three colors. The overall composition is symmetrical and grid-like, with the brown, beige, and pink colors distributed evenly throughout the design. The drawing is on a plain, light-colored background with slight texture and minimal markings outside the main square.
title: Woven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
